module_summary: Wishbone slave RAM: single-port word memory with byte-select writes, registered read data and a one-cycle registered acknowledge per strobe.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: Main RAM array, byte-lane written and read at adr_i_valid.

anchors.name: adr_i
anchors.why: Wishbone byte address shifted to word index.

anchors.name: adr_i_valid
anchors.why: Word index into mem derived from adr_i.

anchors.name: dat_i
anchors.why: Write data stored into selected byte lanes of mem.

anchors.name: dat_o
anchors.why: Read data output driven from dat_o_reg.

anchors.name: dat_o_reg
anchors.why: Registered read data captured from mem on access.

anchors.name: stb_i
anchors.why: Strobe qualifying a bus access with cyc_i.

anchors.name: cyc_i
anchors.why: Bus cycle active qualifier for accesses.

anchors.name: ack_o
anchors.why: Acknowledge driven by ack_o_reg; blocks re-access while asserted.

groups.name: ram_array
groups.description: Word memory with registered read output.

groups.name: wishbone_slave
groups.description: Wishbone access decode and registered ack generation.
